john.10.p1.b1.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.

john.10.p1.b2.text: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep. The gatekeeper opens the gate for him,

john.10.p1.b3.text: and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

john.10.p2.b1.text: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.

john.10.p2.b2.text: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”

john.10.p2.b3.text: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.

john.10.p3.b1.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.

john.10.p3.b2.text: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved.

john.10.p3.b3.text: He will come in and go out and find pasture.

john.10.p4.b1.text: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy.

john.10.p4.b2.text: I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.

john.10.p4.b3.text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

john.10.p5.b1.text: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away.

john.10.p5.b2.text: Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.

john.10.p5.b3.text: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned for the sheep.

john.10.p6.b1.text: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,

john.10.p6.b2.text: Just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father.

john.10.p6.b3.text: And I lay down My life for the sheep.

john.10.p7.b1.text: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice.

john.10.p7.b2.text: Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.

john.10.p7.b3.text: The reason the Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up again.

john.10.p7.b4.text: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again.

john.10.p8.b1.text: Again there was division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message.

john.10.p8.b2.text: “He is demon-possessed and insane. Why would you listen to Him?”

john.10.p8.b3.text: “These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon.

john.10.p8.b4.text: Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”

john.10.p9.b1.text: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,

john.10.p9.b2.text: and Jesus was walking in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade.

john.10.p9.b3.text: “How long will You keep us in suspense?

john.10.p9.b4.text: If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

john.10.p10.b1.text: “I already told you, … but you did not believe.

john.10.p10.b2.text: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.

john.10.p10.b3.text: …No one can snatch them out of My hand.

john.10.p10.b4.text: I and the Father are one.”

john.10.p11.b1.text: At this, the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him.

john.10.p11.b2.text: “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”

john.10.p11.b3.text: “We are not stoning You for any good work, … but for blasphemy,

john.10.p11.b4.text: because You, who are a man, declare Yourself to be God.”

john.10.p12.b1.text: “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?

john.10.p12.b3.text: …so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”

john.10.p12.b4.text: At this, they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped their grasp.

john.10.p13.b1.text: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing, and He stayed there.

john.10.p13.b3.text: Everything he said about this man was true.”

john.10.p13.b4.text: And many in that place believed in Jesus.
